# Polyglot Music

> Polyglot Music is the global standard for making music borderless and accessible to all. It releases songs in 20+ languages in the original artist's own voice, for artists, record labels and music publishers. Every voice. Every language. Perfectly in sync.

## What Polyglot Music does

Polyglot Music makes new-language versions of existing songs, sung in the original artist's own voice and in sync with the original. It is not a cover and not a stand-in singer: it is the artist, in a language the song was never written in.

- Each language version is a new master recording, released alongside the original. The original is never changed.
- Artists and rights holders choose the languages and approve every version before it is released.

## Languages

20+ languages, including English, Spanish, Portuguese, French, German, Italian, Russian, Mandarin, Cantonese, Japanese, Korean, Filipino, Vietnamese, Thai, Indonesian, Turkish, Dutch, Polish, Swedish, Ukrainian, Greek, Romanian and Hebrew, with more on the way.

## Who it is for

- Recording artists and songwriters who want to reach listeners in languages they never recorded in.
- Record labels and music publishers who want to grow the catalog they already own with new-language masters.
- Artist managers planning international releases.

## Team

- Joel Klaiman, co-founder (Music): former EVP/GM of Columbia Records and President of Hitco. Billboard Power 100.
- David Saint Fleur, co-founder (A&R and production): songwriter and record producer, formerly Global A&R at Atlantic Records.
- Austin Dome, co-founder and CEO (Technology): serial founder and AI/ML engineer.

## Related topics

Music dubbing, song dubbing, cross-lingual music, multilingual music, AI music, AI vocal generation, music localization, international music releases, music catalog growth.
